description: Adopt the W3C PROV-O vocabulary for artifact lineage rather than inventing a _sources schema: the Entity/Activity/Agent triad plus wasDerivedFrom / wasGeneratedBy / used already models "this artifact came from those artifacts via that phase, run by that agent". Borrow the vocabulary, not the RDF stack — name the fields after PROV-O terms in existing artifact records so staleness becomes a standard graph-reachability query and a graph export stays possible later. General form of the per-artifact-type staleness tracking already filed. Read the spec before designing anything custom. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-PROV-LINEAGE/plan.md
